title: Shift-Reliance Alignment: Ranking Vision-Language Models by the Cues They Trust
abstract: arXiv:2610.22610v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are usually chosen from leaderboards, which give one ranking for every application. On questions about objects that a scene suggests but does not contain, however, the model with the lowest error on the POPE hallucination benchmark is not the one with the lowest error on such questions. For yes/no questions about object presence, we show that the best model for a target domain can be predicted without running any candidate on that domain, given 650 to 1,200 labeled target items that calibrate a detector. We measure each model's reliance on a cue, a feature such as scene context or text in the image, by editing 100 labeled source images so that the cue suggests the wrong answer, and comparing with a matched control edit. translated_title: 依赖偏移对齐：根据视觉-语言模型所信任的线索对其进行排名
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型通常是从排行榜中挑选的，而排行榜对所有应用只提供同一个排名。然而，对于场景有所暗示但实际并不包含的物体相关的问题，在POPE幻觉基准上错误率最低的模型，并不是在这类问题上错误率最低的模型。针对关于物体是否存在的“是/否”问题，我们证明：只需650到1,200个带标注的目标域样本用于校准一个检测器，就无需在目标域上运行任何候选模型即可预测出该目标域上的最佳模型。我们通过编辑100张带标注的源图像，使某个线索（例如图像中的场景上下文或文字）指向错误答案，并与匹配的对照编辑进行比较，从而测量每个模型对该线索的依赖程度。这种依赖度指标能够预测哪些VLM会被物理贴纸攻击误导（在九个未参与设计该指标的模型上Spearman相关系数为0.93），以及哪些VLM会在未经编辑的COCO照片上产生幻觉，其效果超越了……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种“线索依赖度”测量方法，通过编辑少量图像校准检测器，无需在目标域上运行任何候选模型，即可预测哪个视觉-语言模型在目标域的物体存在性问题上表现最佳，并能预测模型被贴纸攻击误导或产生幻觉的倾向。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cue-reliance measure, calibrated with a small number of edited images, that predicts which vision-language model will perform best on a target domain for object-presence questions without running any candidate model on that domain, and also forecasts models' vulnerability to sticker attacks and hallucination.
